unlisted_practices: LLM-assisted synthesis of executable, human-auditable rule-based clinical prediction systems as an interpretable alternative to black-box models
Retaining validated rule versions along the search trajectory for auditability
Continual revision of previously validated rules under feature evolution or data drift

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-assisted framework (Medical Heuristic Learning) for generating interpretable, auditable clinical decision rules, testing it on retrospective medical datasets.
